description: This file implements the core functions for a Persistent Storage Manager's File Loader object, including creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization. It defines the object lifecycle functions and contains code related to managing persistent storage configuration objects within the CCSP framework.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE PsmFloCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new PSM File Loader object, setting up function pointers and context handles.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS PsmFloRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the PSM File Loader object, canceling ongoing operations and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS PsmFloEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls necessary subordinate objects required for PSM file loading functionality.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS PsmFloInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Performs base class initialization and sets up default properties and function pointers specific to the PSM File Loader object.
